literal: To breathe they exist they are not surely of those who are angry the pride those who cannot destroy.
translation: Those who cannot destroy the pride of their foes are surely not alive, even if they breathe.
modern: பகைவரின் செருக்கை அழிக்க முடியாதவர்கள் மூச்சு விட்டாலும் உயிருடன் இருப்பவர்கள் அல்லர்.
explanation: This couplet states that merely breathing does not mean a person is truly alive. If a leader cannot crush the arrogance of their enemies, their existence is meaningless. The word cemmal here denotes the haughty pride of the foes, and manra emphasizes the absolute certainty of their lifeless state in a figurative sense.
